corrections.was: this packet's brief: `the states' steps for moveto / attackmove / follow / stop` are reconstructed
corrections.is: they are not. docs/SHIP_AI_STATES.md's own coverage table reads `009E14C0, 009E1610, 009E1950, 009E59C0: not read. They are named here only as vtable slots`, and the attackmove step 009e8820 and the kamikaze step 009e2020 were not read either. Only the cruise step 009e1170 has a reconstruction, so eight of the nine leaves are records with their own addresses.

corrections.was: this packet's brief and docs/CRUISE_COMMAND.md: the last hop is `the AI controller block at [state]+8 into unit+0fc4h / unit+0fdch`
corrections.is: there is no such hop. docs/UNIT_AUTOPILOT_PAIR.md establishes that unit+61h gates the ship AI controller off entirely at 009f50fc and selects the autopilot pair at 008266c1, so the two are mutually exclusive. The AI's order goes into the unit's own 84-byte slot at unit+0AECh - 84*[unit+0B40h], and what is missing is the reader of that slot.
